messages:
deploybot: Tag v3.3.1 created on branch release/3.3 — ref `refs/tags/v3.3.1` — commit `a1b2c3d`
deploybot: Target envs: prod-us (canary), prod-eu (hold) — canary window 30m then 2h ramp.
deploybot: Short changelog:
- improve batching heuristic for small seqs
- fix KV cache eviction on 2-token edge-case
- docs: add rollout checklist + pinning notes
deploybot: Release notes: https://intranet/release/3.3.1 — operators, please review pin guidance if you manage Dedicated pools

alice: Ack. tagging here. Any DB migrations or schema changes?

ben: No DB migrations. Only runtime env var bump: `INFER_BATCH_MAX=64` (minor, safe).

celeste: Can we keep prod-eu on hold for 30m? earlier canary in staging showed slight p99 uptick for the EU region.

dave: noted. I'll watch p99/error-rate. if errors >10% or latency >20% vs baseline we roll back.

linda: @jen can you prep the internal release blurb (short) and the external changelog snippet?

jen: on it — will post internal summary in 5m and external changelog snippet after the 30m canary.

alice: Ops: please pin version for Dedicated customers where applicable (cc @ben). Command: `rdwctl pin --env prod-us --tag v3.3.1`

ben: pinned prod-us. leaving prod-eu on hold per request.

deploybot: Canary complete for prod-us at 2163009922 — no regressions detected in our smoke checks. Starting gradual rollout to 50% -> 100% over next 2h.

dave: saw a transient 8% p99 spike during minute 18 of canary, blended baseline back in <2m. looks acceptable. continuing monitor.

celeste: lifting prod-eu hold — metrics look stable in staging and US canary.

ben: deployed to prod-eu at 2163009930 and pinned there too.

deploybot: Rollout to 100% complete for tag v3.3.1 — finished at 2163009935. If you see anomalies, please react in #incidents and tag me.

celeste: thanks team :tada:

alice: documenting rollback steps in the release notes (section: rollback -> how-to). linking after this thread.

jen: internal release note posted: https://intranet/docs/releases/3.3.1/internal — external snippet queued.

dave: marking monitor window open for 4h. will escalate if needed.

ben: last check: smoke tests green, service error-rate steady. good to close the deploy window once monitor is over.
